summary: Iteration 2 validated new case-study fields (problem/goal/process/kpis) on projects, drag-and-drop reorder for Skills/Projects, redesigned About photo card, and mobile 390px layout. Backend: 24/24 pytest passing (added 4 new tests for case-study fields + reorder). Frontend: all requested drag/create/persist/delete/toggle flows verified end-to-end. Test data cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warning fires repeatedly on admin pages that use framer-motion Reorder.Group. Likely caused by useEffect syncing items from data on every re-render (data.filter returns new array each time) combined with Reorder.Group's onReorder callback. Functionality still works but console is spammed and performance may degrade with many items.

issues: Empty string passed to when a project has no cover_url — browser warning 'empty string passed to src'. Use null/undefined or a fallback placeholder in assetUrl().

action_items: Fix 'Maximum update depth exceeded' loop in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/SkillsTools.jsx and ProjectsAdmin.jsx. Suggested: guard the useEffect by comparing ids (e.g., only setItems when data ids differ from current items ids) or memoize with useMemo on data reference/length.
Handle empty cover_url in project row image (avoid empty src attribute).
critical_code_review_comments: SkillsTools.jsx line 42-46: useEffect deps=[data] with eslint-disable but filter is a prop that changes every render. New array from data.filter() triggers setItems every effect run — combined with framer-motion Reorder.Group onReorder causing infinite render loop warning.

ProjectsAdmin.jsx: same pattern (useEffect ->  setItems(data) each time data reference changes). React Query returns stable references normally, but combined with Reorder animation frames it still triggers 'Maximum update depth exceeded'.
ProjectForm.jsx save(): payload filters process by title.trim() but not empty description — good. Consider trimming values before submit to avoid whitespace-only entries.

routes_content.py register_crud: reorder endpoint accepts any ids list without validating that all ids belong to this collection. Malicious/incorrect payload could reorder unrelated records — low risk since admin-only.
assetUrl handling: passing empty string to produces browser warning + extra network request. Wrap with conditional render or default placeholder.

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. React 'Maximum update depth' warning RCA: useEffect(() => { setItems(data.filter(filter)) }, [data]) re-runs on every parent re-render because filter prop (arrow function) makes ListEditor receive new prop reference each render, causing re-render, and Reorder.Group onReorder during animation frames triggers additional setItems calls. Mitigation: (a) memoize filter callback in parent SkillsTools with useCallback, (b) inside effect diff items before calling setItems, or (c) use JSON.stringify(data map ids) as effect dep.
